name: runtime-allocator
description: Tools/perf/runtime-library/allocator.mjs and its Jet twin runtime-library/allocator/run.jet, the matched runtime-object allocator cell (one C driver over the Jet runtime at O0 and O1 and over Rust's std::alloc, seven pinned rounds). The fixtures stand in for the runtime objects with files that are not objects, so every run stops before timing: the refusals of the arguments (no arguments, a CPU that is not a list), a missing or empty measure-job variable, evidence already in the output directory, an input that does not exist (after the output directory is made), and a full build in the checkout: both CheckRuntimeExports steps fail on the stand-ins, allocator.c and allocator.rs build, build.json records the pins and the four steps, and the run exits 1 before linking. The check prints the printed text with the case directory as <case>, the output directories' entries and build.json with the two source hashes as <sha256>.
